description.value: Han Lin Noodle House is a Chinese restaurant in New Westminster that grew out of the former Hons Wun-Tun House, rebranded and relaunched in 2022. The menu spans noodles, dim sum, combo plates, and a dedicated vegetarian selection, with online ordering available for takeout. Its location on 6th Street in central New Westminster makes it a convenient stop on a ride through the Lower Mainland.
